sources.title: TLM 103 product page and technical data (Neumann)

notes: Condenser microphone. Output: XLR (the technical data lists the matching cable connector as XLR 3 F, so the microphone side is XLR male). Needs phantom power. Phantom power: P48 (IEC 61938) per the technical data. The source shows no knobs or switches on the device.
